Lina C: Idea: split query auth responsibility into three layers: UI router (coarse route), access-orch (per-dashboard visibility + downscope), and query nodes (final enforcement). This keeps each piece small.

Marco J: Concern: more services increase cognitive load. Can we keep access-orch tiny and make it optional?

Lina C: Yes optional by tenant via flags. Also wants to keep token format minimal.

Iris T: We'll need detailed SLO/KPI tracking and rollout gates.

Ben O: infra-bot created access-orch repo.

Lina: Action: draft RFC.
